name: Deli Turkey Sandwich with Sun-Dried Tomato Aioli & Side Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 red bell pepper
1 English cucumber
2 heads butter (Boston) lettuce
2 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and roughly chop bell pepper; place in a medium bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Separate lettuce leaves; set aside two leaves per sandwich and chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add chopped lettuce to the bowl and set aside.
Place pesto and mayo in a small bowl; stir to combine the aioli.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup sun-dried tomato pesto
¼ cup mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Spread aioli over each bread slice; layer half of the slices with lettuce, tomato, and turkey. Close sandwiches with remaining bread slices, then slice in half.
instructions.secondary_message: 16 oz oven roasted turkey breast, sliced

instructions.primary_message: Add vinaigrette to the bowl with the veggies and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!
